
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Cwj-XFH/p/19939421" title="发布于 2026-04-28 13:07">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ArrayPoolWrapper简洁、安全的ArrayPool</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain">通过.NET中的 <span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/api/system.buffers.arraypool-1?view=net-8.0" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">ArrayPool</span></a><span class="md-plain"> 我们可以实现对<span class="md-pair-s"><code>T[]</code><span class="md-plain">类型的池化，避免频繁的分配内存和GC，以提升性能。鉴于已有不少博客介绍<span class="md-pair-s"><code>ArrayPool</code><span class="md-plain">的具体原理，本文不会涉及其实现细节。本文聚焦使用中的痛点，并提供简洁的封装方案以提升<span class="md-pair-s"><code>ArrarPool</code><span class="md-plain">使用的便捷性。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>ArrayPool</code><span class="md-plain">本身的使用方式比较简单：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Buffers;
​
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> pool = ArrayPool&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;.Shared.Rent(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 其他逻辑</span>
ArrayPool&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;.Shared.Return(pool);</pre>
</div>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">为了确保在发生异常时能够释放资源，通常需要写成如下形式的样板代码：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>[] pool = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    pool </span>= ArrayPool&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;.Shared.Rent(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 其他逻辑</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (pool != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        ArrayPool</span>&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Shared.Return(pool);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">以上写法会是我们的代码中充斥大量的样板代码和大量的嵌套，影响代码后续的可读性和可维护性。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p md-focus">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">接下来我们在原<span class="md-pair-s"><code>ArrayPool</code><span class="md-plain">的基础上稍加封装，以实现简洁、安全的使用<span class="md-pair-s"><code>ArrayPool</code><span class="md-plain">的目标，代码如下：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> ArrayPoolWrapper&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> : IDisposable
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> _index = -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> _disposed = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _capacity;
​
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> T[] _pool;
​
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ArrayPoolWrapper(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> capacity)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (capacity &lt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(capacity), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">The capacity must be greater than 0.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
​
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._capacity =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> capacity;
        _pool </span>= ArrayPool&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Shared.Rent(capacity);
    }
​
​
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Add(T info)
    {
        ThrowIfDisposed();
​
        _index</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_index &gt;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _capacity)
        {
            _index</span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
​
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">The array pool has reached its capacity.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
​
        _pool[_index] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> info;
    }
​
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Dispose()
    {
        ThrowIfDisposed();
        _disposed </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
​
        ArrayPool</span>&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.Shared.Return(_pool);
    }
​
​
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ThrowIfDisposed()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (_disposed)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ObjectDisposedException(nameof(ArrayPoolWrapper&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">封装后的使用只需一行代码，效果如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> pool = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArrayPoolWrapper&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">我们还可以通过封装来实现更多的扩展API，如：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>RemoveLastOne</code><span class="md-plain">以及基于<span class="md-pair-s"><code>Span</code><span class="md-plain">的切片操作：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> ArrayPoolWrapper&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> : IDisposable
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Count =&gt; _index + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> Span&lt;T&gt; Values =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _pool.AsSpan()[..Count];
​
​
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RemoveLastOne()
    {
        ThrowIfDisposed();
​
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (Count &lt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">The array pool is empty.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
​
        _pool[_index] </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        _index</span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">使用示例如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> pool = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArrayPoolWrapper&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    pool.Add(i);
}
​
pool.RemoveLastOne();
Console.WriteLine(pool.Count);
​
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> i <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> pool.Values[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>..<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
{
    Console.WriteLine(i);
}</span>&nbsp;</pre>
</div>
<p class="md-end-block md-p md-focus"><span class="md-plain">完整的实现代码已在<span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a href="https://github.com/CwjXFH/CodeSnippet/blob/master/dotnet/Widget/src/Extensions/Pool/ArrayPoolWrapper.cs" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">Github</span></a><span class="md-plain md-expand">上开源。</span></span></span></p>
